minValues.description:
Minimum number of non-missing values in window for the final computed result for the window to have a value.
Otherwise, the final result for the window is null or NaN.  "Non-missing value" here refers to an
individual element field, not the entire element.

title:
An intermediate structure holding results of the various windowed operations on {@link Collection}, providing
the ability to perform various aggregations on the window.  Each element field is operated on
independently of the other fields, rather than operating on each element as a whole (equivalent to calculating
on each column in a 2D table independently when there are multiple columns).


Any operation on CollectionRolling should return the same CollectionType as the original collection. e.g. If the
collection which this operation is acting on is a DataTable, the output of the `agg` function should also be a
DataTable.

@see StdLib#rolling
@see StdLib#expanding
name: CollectionWindow
